minutes.headline: PACC approved its minutes and heard routine reports; the FY26 budget, a coming cable contract and studio space were discussed.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee approved its prior minutes as amended by roll call and heard the manager's monthly report on staffing, local programming, interest income and the calendar. Discussion covered the FY26 budget presented to the finance committee, a health insurance increase, a coming cable contract renewal, and the planned studio space in the old library building, which depends on town meeting. The meeting adjourned after a motion and a second.
